mapper.select: SELECT H.ORDER_ID AS ordNo, H.ORDERED_AT AS ordDt, C.CUSTOMER_NAME AS custNm, D.LINE_NO AS itemSeq, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS prdNm, D.QUANTITY * D.UNIT_PRICE AS lineAmt FROM ORDERS H INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = H.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEM D ON D.ORDER_ID = H.ORDER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = D.PRODUCT_ID AND P.IS_SELLABLE = 'Y' WHERE H.ORDER_ID = #{ordNo} ORDER BY D.LINE_NO
SELECT H.ORDER_ID AS ordNo, CC.CODE_NAME AS statNm FROM ORDERS H, COMMON_CODE CC WHERE CC.GROUP_CODE = 'ORD_STAT' AND CC.CODE = H.STATUS AND H.ORDER_ID = #{ordNo}
